title: Yang-Mills Theory and the Mass Gap
description: We prove that four-dimensional lattice Yang-Mills theory with any compact simple gauge group has a mass gap with an explicit lower bound at strong coupling, and that a spectral gap varpi for resampling cubes of physical size l, uniform in the lattice spacing, gives every nontrivial continuum limit the mass gap 16 varpi/(625 e^2 l). We prove this cube gap at strong coupling, for SU(2) up to beta_W = 7/20, and reduce it to a decay of correlations below 1/2 across one slab of width l/2, which we prove in two dimensions and which remains open in four. Detailed version, 69 pages; the continuum mass gap is not proved.
